specification.title: Non-pivotable discoveries are never pivoted
specification.description: A discovery with no deterministic provider path is never pivoted.
specification.purpose: Verify a discovered entity with no deterministic provider path is never enqueued or executed as a pivot.
specification.operational_relevance: Discoveries without provider coverage must not stall or invent new data sources; the investigation drains and terminates.
specification.regression_risk: The coordinator could invent an unsupported provider path or pivot an entity with no legal provider work.

required: The non-pivotable entity never appears as a pivot
forbidden: The coordinator invents provider work for an entity without a deterministic provider path
